manifest.name: claude-dev
manifest.description: Autonomous coding agent right in your IDE, capable of creating/editing files, running commands, using the browser, and more with your permission every step of the way.

walkthroughs.title: Meet Cline, your new coding partner
walkthroughs.description: Cline codes like a developer because it thinks like one. Here are 5 ways to put it to work:

steps.title: Start with a Goal, Not Just a Prompt
steps.description: Tell Cline what you want to achieve. It plans, asks, and then codes, like a true partner.

steps.title: Let Cline Learn Your Codebase
steps.description: Point Cline to your project. It builds understanding to make smart, context-aware changes.

steps.title: Always Use the Best AI Models
steps.description: Cline empowers you with State-of-the-Art AI, connecting to top models (Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI & more).

steps.title: Extend with Powerful Tools (MCP)
steps.description: Connect to databases, APIs, and other external tools through MCP.

steps.title: You're Always in Control
steps.description: Review Cline's plans and diffs. Approve changes before they happen. No surprises.

commands.title: Generate Commit Message with Cline - Stop

scripts.compile: bun run check-types && bun run lint && bun esbuild.mjs
scripts.compile-standalone: bun run check-types && bun run lint && bun esbuild.mjs --standalone
scripts.dev: bun run protos && bun run watch
scripts.package: bun run check-types && bun run lint && bun run build:production
scripts.postprotos: biome format --config-path ./biome.jsonc src/shared/proto src/core/controller src/hosts/ webview-ui/src/services src/generated --write --no-errors-on-unmatched
scripts.clean:build: rimraf dist dist-standalone webview-ui/build src/generated out/
scripts.clean:all: bun run clean:build && bun run clean:deps
scripts.check-types: bun run protos && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun run check-types:compat && cd webview-ui && bunx tsc --noEmit
scripts.ci:build: bun run protos && bun run build:webview && bun esbuild.mjs && bun run compile-tests
scripts.pretest: bun run compile && bun run compile-tests && bun run compile-standalone && bun run lint
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build:production && node src/test/e2e/utils/build.mjs && playwright test
scripts.dev:webview: node scripts/clean-webview-vite-cache.mjs && cd webview-ui && bun run dev
scripts.build:webview: bun run protos && cd webview-ui && bun run build

extractionLimit: Windows tar failed to create upstream instruction/skill symlinks; regular audited source files are present and hashed. Not a complete executable checkout.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun install && bun run build:sdk && bun -F @cline/cli build
scripts.dev: bun --conditions=development run build:sdk && bun run cli && bun run cli hub stop
scripts.test:unit: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; bun -F @cline/agents test & p1=$!; bun -F @cline/llms test & p2=$!; bun -F @cline/core test:unit & p3=$!; bun -F @cline/cli test:unit & p4=$!; bun -F @cline/cline-hub test & p5=$!; bun -F @cline/vscode test & p6=$!; wait $p1; wait $p2; wait $p3; wait $p4; wait $p5; wait $p6'
scripts.verify:routines: zsh -lc 'cd sdk/packages/core && bunx vitest run src/cron/schedule-service.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts'
scripts.format: bun biome format sdk/ apps/cli/ apps/cline-hub/ apps/examples/
scripts.lint: bun biome lint sdk/ apps/cli/ apps/cline-hub/ apps/examples/
scripts.fix: bun biome check --write --unsafe --diagnostic-level=error sdk/ apps/cli/ apps/cline-hub/ apps/examples/
scripts.check: bun biome check --diagnostic-level=error sdk/ apps/cli/ apps/cline-hub/ apps/examples/ && bun run build:sdk && bun run -F @cline/cli build && bun -F @cline/cline-hub build:webview && bun --parallel -F './sdk/packages/**' -F @cline/cli -F @cline/cline-hub typecheck && bun sdk/scripts/check-publish.ts
